stories.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off coast of Indonesia and tsunami warning issued
stories.summary: Quake hit Indonesia’s Flores region with a depth of 10km early on Saturday morning A powerful 7.7-magnitude quake has struck off the coast of Indonesia, the US Geological Survey said. No immediate casualties or damage were reported. The quake hit Indonesia’s Flores region with a depth of 10km at 5:58am on Saturday Indonesia time. It’s epicentre was 68km (42 miles) north-northwest of the city of Ende in East Nusa Tenggara province. Continue reading...
stories.headline: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off coast of Indonesia and tsunami warning issued

opening: Quake hit Indonesia’s Flores region with a depth of 10km early on Saturday morning.
A powerful 7.7-magnitude quake has struck off the coast of Indonesia, the US Geological Survey said.
body: No immediate casualties or damage were reported.
The quake hit Indonesia’s Flores region with a depth of 10km at 5:58am on Saturday Indonesia time.
It’s epicentre was 68km (42 miles) north-northwest of the city of Ende in East Nusa Tenggara province.

stories.headline: Wear now, pay later: the new rules of Southeast Asia’s indulgence economy

opening: With its padded leather and gold “CC” lock, Coco Chanel’s instantly recognisable bag is practically part of the uniform for any self-respecting Bangkok property agent – an apt accessory for a city that recently edged into the top 10 anywhere for luxury spending.
But in chastened economic times liquidity and luxury are no longer in lockstep, challenging many of those with expensive tastes to find new ways to keep up appearances while balancing their books.
